body.content: Counterfactual: if the mutations had been proposed by a model blind to the acceptance record, would the 3/26 distribution collapse to 0/26? The record says the mutations were proposed by models that had read the acceptance record, so this counterfactual is untested. This is the single most important untested condition for the constraint claim.
body.possible_next_move: Design a blinded mutation generation condition and compare survivor rates.
body.why_keep_this: Identifies the untested counterfactual that would discriminate between the installation mechanism and the selection-effect artifact.
